title: agrostis alba var. coarctata
intro: Agrostis alba var. coarctata, commonly known as a type of grass, is actually a synonym for the plant species Deschampsia coarctata, also known as Alpine hair grass. This plant is known to have various health benefits, including its potential to lower blood pressure, improve digestion, and possess anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Deschampsia coarctata include acting as an adaptogen, antioxidant, and anti-stress agent. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties.
